answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by tying earning power to a costly, verifiable work history instead of free identities. Each agent must stake value and complete real tasks through a bridge of on-chain attestations that links its wallet to its output, so reputation compounds only with proven work. A fresh clone starts at the bottom of a deep canyon of zero trust, while an honest agent that keeps delivering climbs toward its zenith — and a sybil farmer would have to pay the full climb for every fake identity, which makes the attack unprofitable.
